caption:
This 1:48 scale Victorian shipyard has taken three years to build, and I just finished the complex pulley systems on the gantry cranes.
One of the figures is actually alive, and she looks absolutely livid about being shoved across the dock by a giant finger. 😠
What would you add to a shipyard of this size if you had all the time in the world?
#scalemodel #miniatureworld #modelmaking #diorama #shipyard
